title: Bluewater Bliss | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the coastal charm of Blue Mountain Beach, Bluewater Bliss is a brand-new retreat designed for effortless vacation living. With room for up to ten guests, this thoughtfully appointed home strikes a perfect balance between laid-back luxury and family-friendly comfort. Two inviting living areas provide the ideal setup for both connection and relaxation—while adults unwind, kids can take over their own space, complete with a classic arcade game for nonstop fun. Just steps away, the open-concept kitchen and dining area set the stage for lively meals and meaningful moments after sun-soaked beach days. Out back, a peaceful porch and grill-ready patio invite alfresco evenings filled with fresh seafood and good company. Nestled in one of 30A’s newest communities, Bluewater Bliss offers easy access to the iconic white-sand beaches and scenic paths that make this stretch of the Gulf Coast so beloved. Whether you're chasing sunsets, exploring local eateries, or simply soaking up the serene setting, this is a home where memories are made and time slows down in all the right ways.
